title: Snapping Tendons
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Place the probe over the symptomatic area and ask the patient to reproduce the movement.
Ask the patient to say when the snap happens, and correlate it with what the screen shows.
Identify the tendon and the prominence it crosses, which names the lesion.
Record a video clip where the equipment allows, because a still image cannot show movement.
